correctness.rationale: Exact Gaussian reward equals sum of one-mode Jeffreys divergences, renewal reward gives r(h_q(r)+h_q(r/K)), and h_q(z)=-B_q z+o(z) near zero and A_q/z^2+O(z^-3) at infinity with positive coefficients. At rates a,b,sqrt(K),Kb four strict alternating signs follow for K sufficiently large. For q=1/2,K=10000, a finite 70-term rational positive series with rigorously bounded tail and exponential interval bounds certified all four numerical sign witnesses in the actual packaged checker; intermediate-value theorem supplies at least three roots. No inference from finite root enumeration or numerical simulation is required.

value.rationale: For the smallest multiscale Gaussian system (two distinct OU relaxation modes), sharing a single reset clock creates at least three clock-choice reversals, invalidating direct extrapolation of single-mode uniqueness. It holds for every nontrivial fixed reset variance ratio with sufficiently large spectral separation; an explicit finite witness facilitates reproducibility. This is a physically meaningful protocol-choice structural distinction rather than an arbitrary numerical invariant; total thermodynamic dissipation is expressly outside scope.
